description: Returns a page of the Cyber Library as markdown with its metadata (title, URL, breadcrumbs, last update, contributors) and, for folders, the list of child pages. Paths look like "offensive/software/applications/server/containers/container-escape"; full URLs are accepted. Docs: https://www.cyberlibrary.com/en/mcp

max_chars.description: Truncate the body after this many characters (default: no limit)

name: get_page
title: Read a library page
